title: Kerala Bank to roll out ‘Gen Z Tech’ loan scheme for students to purchase educational gadgets
content: The loan open to undergraduate students and upwards, the bank will offer up to ₹1 lakh on 6.99% interest with a 30-month repayment period

title: Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: NTA terminates 47 officials as part of complete overhaul
content: Union Cabinet approves draft bill for stricter punishments in paper leak cases; 'Pradhan's resignation non-negotiable', says CJP in meeting with Union Ministers

title: Lack of rain leads to wild elephants camping in human habitations in Kerala’s Munnar
content: The wild elephants typically retreat deep into the forest once the monsoon intensifies. However, this year, the herds have stayed near human habitations due to a scarcity of food and water deeper in the woods

title: Internet rallies behind filmmaker Sibi Malayil after influencer Pearle Maaney’s “failed filmmaker” dig
content: The social media influencer’s take on the Jantar Mantar protests leads to a full-blown Instagram war with Joe Malayil, the National Award-winning director’s son

title: Auto driver murdered in Kalaburagi
content: A 19-year-old auto driver was murdered over a minor dispute at Devala Ganagapur, a popular pilgrimage site in Afzalpur taluk in Kalaburagi district, early on Friday

title: Footpath driving cases soar across Bengaluru; footpath parking cases double
content: Bengaluru has witnessed a sharp rise in driving on footpaths, with 12,032 cases booked in just the first five months of 2026. The annual average for the past six years has been 14,827 cases

title: Cyberabad is mini-India: CP M. Ramesh on traffic woes, Gen Z divide and the future of urban policing
content: Cyberabad has transformed from a sparsely populated outskirts into one of India’s largest technology and business hubs. In an interview, Cyberabad Police Commissioner M. Ramesh speaks about traffic management, community engagement and how policing must evolve alongside a rapidly changing urban society.

title: SC bars unauthorised recording, monetisation of court videos on social media
content: Bench observes that misuse of video clips from livestreamed court proceedings is “trivialising” the administration of justice; the top court, however, clarifies that embargo will not extend to news reporting of court proceedings

title: CET constituent college proposal to be finalised after detailed deliberations, panel assures stakeholders
content: Kerala State Higher Education Council vice-chairperson Achuthsankar S. Nair stated that numerous speculative reports and varying interpretations regarding the proposal have been circulating even before the panel has held its first official meeting

title: Delhi HC declines interim injunction against OpenAI in ANI copyright suit
content: OpenAI’s act of storing ANI’s literary works for training its Large Language Models, prima facie, did not amount to copyright infringement, says judge

title: Peechi tremors: Collector seeks detailed study, more seismographs
content: After multiple reports of ground movements and unusual subterranean sounds in the area, District Collector Shikha Surendran visits homes that suffered structural damage. She proposes compensation for affected families.

title: Pension beneficiaries in A.P. dropped by 3 lakh in two years, says LibTech report
content: The number of sanctioned pensions fell from 65.18 lakh in July 2024 to 62.20 lakh in July 2026, a decline of 4.6%; no fresh pensions under regular categories have been sanctioned since January 2024

title: 13 killed after boulders crush vehicle in Himachal Pradesh
content: SUV carrying 15 people was travelling through Lahaul and Spiti district when rocks fell from a hillside; Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu orders relief and rescue operations

title: Python found in waste bundle at Koyilandy material collection facility; probe launched
content: The incident, which took place last week, came to light when the volunteers revealed the harrowing experience during a ward-level meeting

title: Vedike condemns police action against NEET protesters in New Delhi, seek probe into irregularities in entrance test
content: Members of the Prajasattatmaka Chintana Vedike (Forum for Democratic Thought), along with students, activists and members of civil society, staged a protest in Kalaburagi on Friday, condemning the alleged police action against NEET protesters at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi and demanding that the Union government address concerns over alleged irregularities in the medical entrance examination

title: Two trained kumki elephants deployed in Parvathipuram to tackle human-elephant conflict
content: Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan flags off Jayanth and Abhimanyu to the Guchchimi Elephant Camp, saying they will help forest personnel drive wild elephant herds back into forests and protect lives and crops

title: A.P. government’s aim is holistic development of students, says MA&UD Minister
content: Narayana urges teachers to take special responsibility for the students’ education; claims that the objective of the parent-teacher meeting is to understand the students’ interests and capabilities through their parents and to provide encouragement accordingly

title: School authorities, teachers in Kerala upset over KFON’s decision on bills
content: KFON asks schools to bear service charges associated with Internet connectivity. Schools say free Internet service was to be provided to them through KFON. Service charges for schools are not a newly imposed financial liability, contends KFON

title: Police foil BJP march to Congress office, detain party leaders
content: Accusing the Congress government of politicising the NEET protest at Jantar Mantar and presiding over a deteriorating law-and-order situation, BJP leaders and party workers took out a protest march to the District Congress office in Kalaburagi city on Friday

title: Centre prioritised railway infra development in Andhra Pradesh, says Ashwini Vaishnaw
content: The government has increased the annual budget allocation over 11 times to ₹10,134 crore for FY 2026–27 from an average of ₹886 crore during 2009–14, the Railway Minister tells Rajya Sabha

title: Government Flying School licence in Karnataka’s Jakkur renewed; training to resume soon
content: The GFTS’s existing runway is 954-metres long and a proposal has been prepared to acquire 10 acres of land to extend it by another 160 metres

title: German national railway company Deutsche Bahn delegation visits IIIC in Kerala’s Kollam
content: The 13-member delegation from Berlin included senior representatives from Deutsche Bahn, its subsidiaries such as DB Engineering & Consulting GmbH and DB Rail Academy, as well as key industry suppliers and project partners

title: Like children, vulnerable elderly need a State-led care and protection mechanism: Karnataka High Court
content: The Karnataka High Court asks the government to examine the feasibility of creating a comprehensive policy or legislative framework for ‘senior citizens in need of care and protection’ on the lines of the JJ Act

title: Revenue dept. targets 25,000 pending land cases in Kozhikode
content: Highlighting the magnitude of pendency across the State, Revenue Minister A.P. Anil Kumar noted that nearly 2.5 lakh applications for land conversion remained pending Statewide, with Kozhikode district accounting for over 35,000 cases

title: Anti-Tobacco Forum opposes enhanced aid for FCV growers
content: Forum questions Centre’s dual policy on tobacco cultivation and urges Centre to promote alternative crops instead of subsidising tobacco

title: Kerala tests drone surveillance at Viyyur central prison
content: Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala reviews pilot project featuring AI-powered surveillance, thermal imaging and automated monitoring; State plans phased rollout to other prisons

title: Students, NSUI stage protest over NEET imbroglio; around 15 protesters detained
content: Condemning the alleged police brutalities on students protesting over NEET imbroglio in Delhi and demanding resignation of union ministers Dharmendra Pradhan and Amit Shah and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, scores of students led by NSUI and Congress office bearers staged a demonstration in Hubballi on Friday

title: Delhi High Court refuses to entertain PIL seeking NIA probe into CJP’s ‘Chalo Sansad’ march
content: A Bench of Chief Justice D. K. Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia said the alleged incidents of vandalism were given the knowledge and notice of the authorities, who would take action according to the law

title: NH 66 expansion in Kollam hit by multiple hurdles
content: Official deadlines for the Kottankulangara–Kollam Bypass section have been extended from October 2024 to December 31, 2027. Similarly, the timeline for the stretch from the bypass to Kadambattukonam has been extended from March 2025 to June 30, 2027

title: AIMSS seeks remedial measures over alarming increase in adolescent pregnancy cases in Dharwad district
content: Expressing alarm over growing instances of adolescent pregnancy and demanding immediate release of pending social security pension, members of All India Mahila Samsrutik Sanghatan (AIMSS) submitted a memorandum to Deputy Commissioner of Dharwad on Friday

title: Dairy farmer’s death: father seeks probe to expose suspected accomplices
content: Rajan, the victim’s father, on Friday said the accused, T.M. Deepak, was addicted to drugs and was unlikely to have committed the murder on his own. He appealed to the police to quiz Deepak’s close friends, alleging that they would have more information about the circumstances leading to the killing

title: NEET row: Centre airlifts more CRPF companies to Delhi as CJP protest continues
content: In a significant move to reinforce security in Delhi, additional CRPF companies are being airlifted. The city sees a continuation of a month-long protest led by students and activists advocating for the resignation of the education minister. As Independence Day approaches, security forces are amplifying their presence, while ongoing discussions between the government and protest leaders aim to achieve a peaceful resolution.

title: There are Chinese projects on territories in J&K that belong to India: MEA
content: Ministry of External Affairs accused China of violating sovereignty and illegally occupying Indian territories.  The government objected to Chinese projects in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.  This statement follows a meeting between Indian and Chinese foreign ministers.  Chinese officials highlighted positive developments in bilateral relations and cooperation.  Both nations aim to maintain peace and explore coexistence as major powers.

title: 'I'll work with him': Joshi reveals plans to develop Sooryavanshi's bowling
content: India's bowling coach Sunil Joshi wants attention on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's batting achievements.  Sooryavanshi became the youngest player to score a T20I fifty against Zimbabwe.  Joshi also advised patience with emerging all-rounder Suryansh Shedge.  He highlighted the bowling depth within the Indian squad.  Ravi Bishnoi's run-up adjustment has yielded positive results for the spinner.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: Up to 10-year jail & Rs 10 crore fine: Cabinet clears tougher anti-paper leak Bill
content: Bill seeks to double punishment for paper leak offences; minimum jail term may rise from 3 years to 5 years

title: US new visa restriction targets individuals involved in cybercrime
content: The United States has introduced a new global visa restriction policy. This measure targets individuals involved in cybercrime and cyber-enabled offenses. Online investment scams and sextortion perpetrators face these new restrictions. Immediate family members of those responsible may also be subjected to visa limitations. The administration is deploying various tools to dismantle criminal scam networks.

title: 'She didn't disclose her whereabouts': JFI chief confirms Tulika Maan's CWG withdrawal
content: Judoka Tulika Maan faces withdrawal from the Glasgow Games for whereabouts failures.  This follows judoka Arun Kumar's disqualification after a failed dope test.  Athletes must disclose their locations for random anti-doping agency testing.  Hima Das and Parveen Hooda previously faced similar whereabouts rule violations.  These incidents impact India's judo prospects at the upcoming sporting event.

title: Malibu homes survived wildfires, but owners still cut prices by up to $7m
content: Malibu's luxury homes are struggling to sell after recent wildfires. Buyers now prioritize safety and insurance over prime locations. Sellers are reducing prices by millions to attract cautious buyers. Rising insurance premiums and climate risks weigh heavily on the market. Malibu remains desirable, but resilience is now a key selling point.

title: Florida pastor says ChatGPT almost killed him; asked him to ignore 'dangerous symptoms’
content: A Florida pastor has sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT provided dangerous medical advice.  The chatbot reportedly diagnosed conditions and recommended treatments without professional guidance.  He claims the AI encouraged him to ignore worsening symptoms and avoid hospital care.  This led to a life-threatening pulmonary embolism, according to the lawsuit.  OpenAI states ChatGPT is not a doctor and should not replace medical care.

title: Noida Twin Towers case explained: Why was it demolished, legal trouble and more
content: Noida's Supertech Twin Towers faced demolition after being ruled illegal, following the Supreme Court's validation of the High Court's order. Apartment buyers are embroiled in ongoing legal battles about refunds. The insolvency case of Supertech complicates matters for claimants waiting for reimbursements, while the Supreme Court investigates alternative solutions to address buyer claims.

title: CJP protest: RAF probes excessive force, pellet gun charges in July 20 crackdown
content: The Rapid Action Force is verifying its personnel's actions during recent student protests. Allegations of excessive force and pellet gun use are being examined by officials. The Central Reserve Police Force is overseeing this internal review process. Videos showing clashes and alleged attacks on personnel are under scrutiny. This verification follows student demands for the education minister's resignation.

title: From mats to Octagon: Why Tyrell Fortune believes his strongest weapon never changed
content: A decorated wrestler before entering mixed martial arts, Tyrell Fortune believes the qualities that shaped his career remain his biggest strength inside the UFC. Following a confidence-boosting debut on short notice, the American heavyweight heads into his second fight with a full training camp, convinced he belongs among the division's elite and determined to move another step closer to the title.

title: Suniel Shetty reveals how he met KL Rahul and why he regrets not buying an IPL team
content: Actor Suniel Shetty admired cricketer KL Rahul as a fan long before their family connection.  He focuses on character discussions at home rather than career advice.  Shetty admits he could have afforded an IPL franchise in its early days.  He lacked the necessary backing and ecosystem for such an investment then.  Shah Rukh Khan's successful IPL venture is attributed to his timing and support.

title: Cabinet approves Ballari-Guntakal rail project to boost freight, passenger connectivity
content: The Union cabinet approved a Rs 1,264-crore railway project for new lines. This initiative will enhance freight movement and passenger connectivity across key states. The project aims to ease congestion and improve logistics efficiency significantly. Additional rail capacity will facilitate smoother movement of passengers and goods. This expansion is scheduled for completion by 2028-29.

title: 'Anna part 2': Congress MP accuses Wangchuk of striking a deal with govt; BJP hits back
content: Congress MP Imran Masood accused activist Sonam Wangchuk of striking a deal with the government.  He compared Wangchuk to Anna Hazare, suggesting future silence from the activist.  The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized Congress for stooping low and insulting the climate activist.  Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike after negotiations with Union ministers.  Meanwhile, the Cockroach Janata Party continues protests demanding a minister's resignation.

title: West Indies pacer 'declines selection' for Pakistan Test series
content: "Yeah, it is a big loss. Mr Joseph has declined selection. That's the reality of the situation," Sammy said at a press conference on the eve of the series opener.

title: Netra, AWACS & Mk II: Inside India's tiered airborne surveillance shield
content: India's airborne surveillance program enters a new phase with AEW&C Mk II development.  Six Airbus A321 aircraft will be converted for this advanced airborne warning system.  Adani Defence Systems will partner in developing the crucial mission systems for these platforms.  This initiative aims to enhance India's air defence capabilities significantly.  The program strengthens India's self-reliance in critical defence technologies.

title: 105 million sq ft and counting: GCCs drive 37% of India's office leasing since 2022
content: Global capability centres are significantly reshaping India's office market. Foreign companies leased nearly 105 million sq ft of premium office space since 2022. This leasing activity represents a substantial portion of overall office transactions nationwide. India's appeal as a destination for these centres continues to grow. Future demand for office space is expected to remain strong due to GCC expansion.

title: Russell Wilson, Ciara relist $45m California estate at lower asking price
content: Russell Wilson and Ciara have reportedly lowered the asking price of their Rancho Santa Fe estate from $54.9 million to $45 million as they prepare for life after the NFL. The luxury property features a private football field, recording studio, wellness center, and guesthouse. The move follows Wilson's retirement and transition into broadcasting with CBS Sports, making an East Coast base more practical for the couple.

title: US-Saudi nuclear deal: Why Riyadh's uranium enrichment plans may worry Israel and India
content: The United States and Saudi Arabia signed a nuclear cooperation agreement. This deal allows Saudi Arabia to acquire uranium enrichment capability for civilian energy. Experts warn this move could dangerously blur the line between civilian and weapons-grade enrichment. Regional rivals like Israel express sharp concerns about a potential nuclear arms race. The agreement raises fears of escalating instability in the volatile Middle East region.

title: India name Chess Olympiad squads as Gukesh, Pragg, Vaishali lead title defence
content: Team India has announced formidable squads for the upcoming FIDE Chess Olympiad.  Defending champions aim to retain both open and women's team titles.  Prominent players like Gukesh and Praggnanandhaa will lead the men's team.  Vaishali, a recent Women's Candidates winner, spearheads the women's lineup.  Viswanathan Anand now serves as the interim FIDE president.

title: 'He is fit': Delhi Police debunks fake newspaper clipping claiming Dipke's death
content: Delhi Police dismissed as fake a viral newspaper clipping claiming the death of Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke, confirming he is safe and healthy. Authorities warned of strict legal action against those spreading misinformation. The clarification comes amid ongoing CJP-led protests over alleged exam irregularities, education reforms and ministerial accountability.

title: Sensex down 900 points, Nifty50 ends below 23,800: Why stock market crashed today
content: Indian stock markets closed lower for a fifth consecutive session on Friday. Rising oil prices and Middle East tensions fueled investor caution and market pressure. Foreign institutional investors continued their selling trend, impacting market sentiment negatively. Renewed concerns over US trade tariffs also contributed to the overall market decline. Selling in heavyweight stocks like Infosys and HDFC Bank added to the day's losses.

title: BHAVYA Rasayan scheme: Cabinet approves Rs 3,030 crore for three chemical parks
content: The Union cabinet approved a new Rs 3,030-crore scheme for three dedicated chemical parks. This initiative aims to strengthen India's chemicals sector with world-class infrastructure. The Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana Rasayan scheme will be implemented over five years. The Centre will provide up to Rs 1,000 crore grant for each park. This plan seeks to boost manufacturing, attract investments, and create jobs.

title: NEET paper leak: No bail for doc accused of taking Rs 5L for leaked chemistry paper
content: A Delhi court has dismissed a bail request from a doctor entangled in the NEET paper leak controversy. The paediatrician reportedly accepted five lakh rupees from a candidate's family and connected two other doctors to the suspected mastermind. The court has now prolonged the judicial custody of all thirteen accused as the investigation focuses on crucial digital evidence.

title: 'You do whatever you like?' Delhi HC pulls up EC for deploying teachers for SIR duties
content: The Delhi high court questioned the Election Commission regarding teacher deployments.  The court sought legal authority for compelling teachers to perform election duties.  The commission cited Article 324 and the Representation of the People Act.  Teachers are reportedly engaged during holidays and non-teaching hours.  The court questioned the mandatory nature of these election assignments.

title: 12.5% to 10%: Why Trump admin imposed reduced tariff rate on India & what it means
content: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the revised tariffs on 60 economies on Thursday, one day before the expiry of the temporary additional 10% duties that had been imposed on imports from all countries.

title: Joe Root set to return as England captain, to lead till Ashes
content: England's search for a new Test captain following Ben Stokes' retirement from international cricket now appears set to end with Root returning to the role.

title: Centre moves to block Bitchat over terror, surveillance concerns amid CJP protest
content: India's cybercrime center has asked GitHub to remove the Bitchat application. This app allows anonymous, offline messaging which raises security concerns for the government. Officials believe it could be misused by terrorists and criminal groups for coordination. The notice cites potential violations of the Information Technology Act. This action follows the use of similar apps during recent Delhi protests.

title: Studying in US? Universities issue urgent advisory ahead of major DHS visa policy shift
content: US universities have advised international students to return before September 15, 2026, ahead of a major immigration policy change replacing the "duration of status" system with a fixed admission period. The new DHS rule will require students to closely monitor authorised stay dates, making timely travel and visa compliance more important for continuing their education uninterrupted.

title: TOI Exclusive: Olympian Tulika Maan provisionally suspended by NADA, set to miss Glasgow CWG
content: India's Commonwealth Games campaign has suffered a setback after Olympian and Birmingham 2022 silver medallist Tulika Maan was provisionally suspended by NADA for alleged whereabouts failures. The suspension rules her out of Glasgow 2026, with the heavyweight judoka facing anti-doping proceedings that could result in a ban of up to two years if upheld.

title: India's fertiliser game plan: 32 lakh tonnes imported in Q1; strengthened supply chains
content: India imported over 32 lakh tonnes of key fertilizers during the first quarter. Domestic production of fertilizers reached 115.72 lakh tonnes in the same period. The government is diversifying import sources to mitigate supply chain risks. Long-term agreements are being finalized with overseas suppliers for fertilizer security. India is sourcing water-soluble fertilizers from multiple countries to offset shortfalls.

title: 10% US tariff on India: What it means for the country's exports
content: United States imposed a ten percent tariff on Indian goods, offering some relief. Economists believe the immediate impact on India's exports will be limited. Reducing dependence on single markets and broadening global reach is crucial. Certainty after months of shifting proposals is a positive development. Sustained export growth depends on competitiveness and diversification efforts.

title: NDTV Exclusive: Chief Justice Surya Kant Clarifies "Don't Waste Our Time" Remark
content: "It was reported wrongly that the Supreme Court declined to hear the petition," Chief Justice of India Surya Kant told NDTV

title: 'Engage With Youth On Instagram, Post Reels': PM Modi To Ministers
content: In the Cabinet meeting, PM Modi asked how many of his colleagues actively use Instagram, one of the most used social media platforms in the world.

title: Bombay High Court Notifies 2 Special Courts For Paper Leak Cases
content: The decision came a day after the central government assured setting up of fast-track courts to hear cases related to malpractices in examinations.

title: Centre Plans "Overhaul" Of Testing Body NTA That Conducts NEET, JEE: Sources
content: One of the key changes includes tweaking the NTA's outsourcing methods in order to ensure a leak-proof system

title: Delhi Police Apologies After Video Of Lawyers Being Manhandled Goes Viral
content: According to the lawyers, senior members of the legal fraternity intervened after videos of the incident went viral, following which the written apology was issued by the head constable.

title: Opinion: Opinion | The Great Pickaxe Challenge: Can Trump Really Destroy Iran's Most Guarded Nuclear Fortress?
content: If Fordow could not be destroyed, the facility at Pickaxe is deeper, more concealed, and with added layers of concrete.

title: ACC Begins FY27 With Resilient Performance, Eyes Stronger Quarters Ahead
content: The Adani Group cement company reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 5,808 crore for the April-June quarter (Q1 FY27), while operating EBITDA stood at Rs 457 crore with a margin of 7.9 per cent.

title: Nearly 40,000 People Evacuated Amid Wildfire In Southwest France: Minister
content: Hundreds of firefighters have, for the past few days, been fighting the flames dozens of kilometres west of Bordeaux.

title: At Least 17 Killed As Russia, Ukraine Exchange Deadly Long-Range Strikes
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said a Russian missile strike outside the Ukrainian capital killed six people, with a rescue operation ongoing.

title: 'Dharmendra Pradhan's Resignation Not On Cards, Easiest Decision To Make': Sources
content: The student protesters, led the the CJP, have been demanding the 57-year-old Minister's resignation over the NEET paper leak.

title: CJP Protest LIVE Updates: Members Of Cockroach Janta Party, Centre Conclude 2nd Round Of Talks
content: CJP Jantar Mantar protest LIVE: Activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day fast at Gurugram's Medanta Hospital last night after the government gave him assurances.

title: Iran Military Claims Drone Strikes On US Bases In Kuwait, Jordan, Bahrain
content: Tehran argues that any facility or base in the Middle East that the US military uses for strikes on Iran is considered a legitimate target for retaliation.

title: Spain Declares National Emergency Over Wildfires Amid Europe Heatwave
content: French authorities ordered the total evacuation of nealy 40,00 people in the Cap Ferret peninsula, while more than 10,000 people were evacuated from the west of Madrid, Spain.

title: Amid Protests, Jack Dorsey Says Centre Ordered Removal Of Chat App Bitchat
content: In its notice, I4C said that the app enables communication even during network restrictions and creates a substantial risk of misuse by anti-national elements, terrorist organisations, organised criminal groups and cyber criminals seeking to evade lawful detection.

title: Rs 3 Crore Stolen From Maharashtra Council Deputy Chair's Home, Help Arrested
content: The accused, identified as Pravin Ramesh Solanki, was produced before the Esplanade Court, which remanded him to police custody till July 30 to enable investigators to trace the stolen valuables and identify other suspects.

title: Ex-RJD Spokesperson Mrityunjay Tiwari Joins BJP Days After Quitting Party
content: Mrityunjay Tiwari had on July 16 issued a video statement, announcing that he was quitting the RJD as he was "feeling suffocated" in the party.

title: Cabinet Approves Rs 3,030 Crore Scheme To Set Up 3 Chemical Parks
content: Under the scheme, the Centre will facilitate the development of three dedicated Chemical Parks by the State Governments under the Challenge Route.

title: Bangladesh President Mohammed Shahabuddin Resigns Citing Health Issues
content: Shahabuddin, 76, has held the largely ceremonial post of president since April 2023, and is a former ally of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

content: The Tata Sumo vehicle was traveling from Kullu to Pangi when rocks started to fall on it and the vehicle got buried.
